comparison.objective: Recover finishing media from washers, versus load an SSD into a server drive carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring and granular bridge clearing versus precise rigid-part orientation and multi-pin seating against a sprung rail.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media with retained workpieces and no spill, versus all carrier pins engaged with the SSD flat, correctly oriented and stable.
comparison.reason: Both require careful placement, but the tested abilities and failure modes differ.
